set_aside.subject: read-triggered empty manual budget creation
set_aside.text: “the progress list first creates the empty manual budget version when the project has none”
set_aside.question: Which module capability performs this write, which AuthorizedProjectContext capability permits it, and who appends the required budget.manual_version_create audit?
options: list_project_progress owns the exceptional write under portal.progress.read and appends the audit
list_project_progress calls budget_management.ensure_manual_budget through a special archived-read path
the route obtains separate budget-management authorization before listing progress
set_aside.default_guess: Have list_project_progress coordinate budget_management.ensure_manual_budget under the already-authorized progress read, with budget_management owning creation and its audit.

set_aside.subject: atomicity of progress listing and automatic budget creation
set_aside.text: “the progress list first creates the empty manual budget version … [then the list capabilities] read the project's records”
set_aside.question: If the empty budget is created but the subsequent progress read fails, does the budget and its audit remain committed or are both rolled back with the failed list operation?
options: Creation and listing are one transaction, so the budget and audit roll back
Budget creation commits first, so the request fails but the budget and audit remain
The creation remains but its audit is rolled back or omitted
set_aside.default_guess: Treat creation, audit, and progress reading as one transaction and roll everything back if the list cannot complete.

witness.initial: An archived project has no manual BudgetVersion and the staff member is authorized to read its progress.
events: The staff member requests the progress list.
The service creates the exceptional empty manual BudgetVersion and its audit.
The progress-record read then fails with a persistence error.
outcomes: The request returns 500 and no BudgetVersion or audit remains.
The request returns 500, but the empty BudgetVersion and budget.manual_version_create audit remain committed.
witness.observer: The staff member on a later budget read, and an administrator inspecting audit history.

set_aside.subject: concurrent first progress reads
set_aside.text: “the progress list first creates the empty manual budget version when the project has none”
set_aside.question: How are concurrent progress-list requests that both encounter no manual budget classified after one creates the single allowed version?
options: Both requests succeed and the loser reuses the version created by the winner
One succeeds and the other fails with a persistence conflict
The requests are serialized before the absence check
set_aside.default_guess: Serialize or retry the ensure operation so both reads succeed while exactly one version and one creation audit are written.

witness.initial: An archived project has no manual BudgetVersion; two authorized staff requests can list its progress.
events: Staff member A requests the progress list.
Staff member B requests the same list concurrently.
Both initially observe that no manual BudgetVersion exists.
outcomes: Exactly one version and audit are created, and both list requests succeed.
A creates the version and succeeds; B reaches the uniqueness constraint and receives a 500 persistence conflict.
witness.observer: Staff member B and an administrator inspecting the single creation audit.
